summary: The generic half-memory frame inequality remains open. The route exactly freezes the dual tail under a cycle-plus-cut representation, reduces the covariance question to a nested cyclic-arc inequality S<=C_tail P, proves a conditional Pythagorean dual hierarchy and a frozen operator-valued random-rank Gram identity, closes signed equicorrelation and generic complement size at most two, and analytically refutes pathwise, reversal-paired, and remaining-frame inverse-Bellman closures.

claims.statement: For every unit-diagonal SPD A and q=ceil(n/2), the half-memory dual state satisfies P Q^{-1} P >= c mu A^{-1} for a universal c>0.
open_objections: No generic dimension-free arc-tail covariance bound is known
No generic local-frame preconditioner lower bound is supplied by this route

claims.statement: Conditional dual regression certificates are monotone under refinement, with the exact Pythagorean gain C_H-C_G=E[(W_H-W_G)^T Q_H(W_H-W_G)].
assumptions: The conditional Q matrices are invertible; singular cases are interpreted by continuity on their support
open_objections: No independent hostile audit has yet reconstructed the general identity

claims.statement: For frozen coefficients and independent uniform row/column ranks, lower-inclusive and strict-upper masks satisfy E[G W G^T]=E[H W H^T]+C W C^T/m for every fixed symmetric W.
assumptions: C and W are fixed before the random ranks
Row and column rankings are independent and uniform
open_objections: Actual RPCD local-solve rows are adapted and do not satisfy the frozen-coefficient hypothesis

claims.statement: Conditional on a directed cycle, the half-memory defect and the entire dual tail F^T D are fixed cyclic local rows multiplied by cut-arc masks; their cut covariance is the exact nested Hardy form (C6).
assumptions: The linear order is generated by a directed cycle and a uniform cut
open_objections: No independent hostile audit has yet reconstructed the all-dimensional proof

claims.statement: The generic covariance comparison follows from the concrete arc-tail inequality S<=C_tail P; scalar Hardy summation alone necessarily loses Theta(n).
assumptions: Definitions P,Q,S use the q=ceil(n/2) local inverse
A separate lower bound P>=c_P mu A^{-1} is available for transfer to the final target
open_objections: The dimension-free inequality S<=C_tail P is open
The adapted signed off-diagonal row covariance is uncontrolled

claims.statement: The generic arc-tail comparison holds with C_tail=1/2 for n=4,5 and with C_tail<7/4 for n=6,7.
open_objections: The analytic proof has not yet received an independent hostile audit
The exact verifier samples n<=6; n=7 follows from the same m=2 symbolic argument

claims.statement: The arc-tail route gives S<=e^{-2}P for positive equicorrelation and, for every negative equicorrelation, S<=3P and P Q^{-1} P >= (mu/30)A^{-1}; diagonal-sign conjugates inherit the bounds.
open_objections: The new negative-family proof has not yet received an independent hostile audit
This structured family does not cover generic SPD matrices

claims.statement: For A=I+epsilon H, the leading half-memory tail covariance is epsilon^2[p2 H^2+(p1-p2)Diag(diag H^2)] and is below epsilon^2 I/8 when ||H||<=1.
assumptions: H is symmetric with zero diagonal
The remainder is interpreted at fixed n and fixed H
open_objections: The O(epsilon^3) remainder is not uniform in dimension
No independent hostile audit has yet reconstructed the coefficient formula

claims.statement: No dimension-free pathwise comparison Q_pi<=Gamma R_pi can hold for the half-memory state, even when mu is uniformly bounded below.
assumptions: The proposed Gamma is independent of dimension
open_objections: This counterexample concerns one exponentially rare order and does not refute full averaging

claims.statement: Pairing an order only with its full reversal does not yield a dimension-free covariance/frame comparison, even with a factor 1/mu.
open_objections: This does not refute averaging over all internal ranks

claims.statement: The proposed remaining-frame inverse Bellman inequality is false even for the structured RPCD covariance lift.
assumptions: The lift acts on Sym(span(v_i)) with v_i=(e_0+e_i)/sqrt(2)

iteration.deepest_obstruction: After cycle conditioning, the dual tail is a fixed arc-mask process, but the nested arc energy contains signed off-diagonal products of different adapted local-solve rows. Scalar Hardy or rowwise Schur bounds lose Theta(n), while complement spectral radii can be Theta(n). A proof must retain modewise Schur decay and off-diagonal cancellation across the random cycle, or quantitatively lower-bound the corresponding Pythagorean information gains.

limitations: The generic dimension-free multirow covariance/frame inequality remains open.
The route does not prove a generic lower bound P>=c mu A^{-1}; covariance closure alone would still need that input.
The signed-equicorrelation and m<=2 conclusions are unaudited E3 proof candidates, not promoted theorems.
The near-identity expansion has no dimension-uniform remainder radius.
The exact counterexamples refute proof methods, not RPCD or the conjectured complexity.
No literature or novelty priority claim was made in this route.
